name: Rewire a nerve from a nearby healthy donor
description: Cut an expendable working nerve fascicle near the target muscle and suture it to the paralysed nerve, so that regrowth starts close to the muscle instead of at the original injury.

grade.note: The Oberlin transfer (ulnar fascicle to biceps branch) restored elbow flexion in patients with C5-C6 avulsion where no repair at the plexus was possible (Oberlin 1994), and nerve transfers are now standard for proximal injuries. It works because it shortens the distance, which is a workaround for the clock rather than a fix for it. Donor nerves for intrinsic hand muscles do not exist in the same way.

wouldMove: A transfer strategy that restores intrinsic hand function after a proximal injury, which no donor currently provides.
